title: build.py never built the On Air page .gitignore says it builds
body:
## Summary
prototype/identity/on-air.html is listed in .gitignore under "regenerate with python prototype/build.py", but build.py wrote only study-desk.html and no builder for it ever existed.

## Description
.gitignore:25-27; prototype/build.py (before) replaced /*__DATA__*/null in src/index.html only. prototype/identity/on-air.src.html:71 holds url("__MATH_IMG__"); git log -S __MATH_IMG__ finds only the commit that added it. The On Air reference (the design law for every TV surface) opened from a clone shows page 2's "read as" panel as a broken image. Fixed: build.py also writes identity/on-air.html with data.json's maths page inline, and stops on any __NAME__ placeholder left in an output.

## Flow
- python prototype/build.py
- before: study-desk.html only; on-air.src.html shows url("__MATH_IMG__")
- after: both built; seeded __SEEDED__ -> exit 1 naming it

## Expected impact
The On Air reference renders whole from a clone. Could break: nothing; study-desk.html is byte-identical to the old builder's output.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every declared build output is built
Before: outputs built 1/2; unresolved placeholders in the On Air page 1
After: 2/2; 0; seeded leftover placeholder -> exit 1
Method: probe - build, compare, seed; no gate covers prototype/
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The recap title said "two things" whatever the list held
body:
## Summary
endSession() in prototype/src/index.html titled every recap with a second-hint item "Good session — two things to look at together".

## Description
The title was a fixed string; the list under it held 1..n items. Fixed: the count in words, as the Tonight title already does.

## Flow
- escalate one item, end the session
- before: "two things" over a one-item list
- after: "one thing"

## Expected impact
The prototype's recap stops misreporting. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the title matches the list
Before: right 1/3 for 1, 2, 3 items
After: 3/3
Method: probe - the page's own script under a vm DOM stub with the real data.json
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Seeking forward ran the lesson clock past its end
body:
## Summary
The D-pad seek (+10 s) in prototype/src/index.html did not clamp to the lesson duration; the playback tick does.

## Description
openLesson's tick: Math.min(DATA.lessons[vid].duration, lessonT + 1); the lesson keydown branch: lessonT += 10. Fixed: the seek clamps the same way.

## Flow
- 5 s before the end, ArrowRight twice
- before: "7:40 / 7:25", bar 103.4%
- after: "7:25 / 7:25", bar 100%

## Expected impact
The prototype's scrubber cannot overrun. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one bound on both writers
Before: 7:40 / 7:25, bar 103.4%
After: 7:25 / 7:25, bar 100%
Method: probe - the page's own keydown handler under a vm DOM stub
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: prototype/src/index.html openLesson tick vs the lesson keydown ArrowRight

title: Two On Air reference sites sit at 24 px, off the type scale the design doc sets
body:
## Summary
prototype/identity/on-air.src.html:55 (.chan) and :65 (.p1 .card .m) use 24 px, which is neither the label band (20-22) nor the small-figure band (26-30) of docs/DESIGN-ON-AIR.md.

## Description
docs/DESIGN-ON-AIR.md:77-82: labels 20-22 px, small figures 26-30 px, nothing else under 28. Both sites are Barlow Condensed 600, one tabular (a figure). Proposed: both to 26 (small figures). A reference page others copy should obey the scale it documents.

## Flow
- count font-size declarations in the stage CSS against the table
- before: 2 off-scale
- build: 24 -> 26 at both sites, capture page 1 before and after

## Expected impact
The reference agrees with its rulebook. Could break: page 1's card row reflows by 2 px per line.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the reference obeys its type scale
Before: 2 sites off the scale
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the count is measured; the layout effect needs a capture this tree cannot take without a browser harness
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Playwright capture of the built prototype/identity/on-air.html page 1 at 1920x1080 before/after, plus the off-scale font-size count (2 -> 0)

title: The built pages load Google Fonts though build.py says a published page loads nothing
body:
## Summary
prototype/build.py's docstring rules that a published page 'may load nothing from anywhere else'; prototype/src/index.html:2 and prototype/identity/on-air.src.html:2 link fonts.googleapis.com.

## Description
Both built outputs keep the stylesheet link, so offline or under a publisher that blocks external loads the pages fall back to Arial/Helvetica and lose the On Air type (Barlow, Barlow Condensed) or IBM Plex. No font file is tracked in the tree (git ls-files *.woff2 / *.ttf: 0), so inlining needs a one-time fetch. Options: commit the woff2 subsets and have build.py inline them as @font-face data URLs, or drop the rule from the docstring.

## Flow
- open the built study-desk.html offline
- before: 1 external load per built page (2 pages)
- after: 0, fonts inline

## Expected impact
The built pages are self-contained as claimed. Could break: page weight rises by the font subsets (~50-150 KB each).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - built pages self-contained
Before: external loads per built page: 1 (2/2 pages)
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the fonts must be fetched once, and no agent here may use the network
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: prototype/build.py docstring; prototype/src/index.html:2; prototype/identity/on-air.src.html:2; git ls-files fonts: 0
instrument: operator-only: fetch the Barlow / Barlow Condensed / IBM Plex woff2 subsets once and commit them; then count external URLs in the built outputs (2 -> 0)
